eval.title: Kaiser Aluminum KALU Getting Interesting Due To Temporary Issues

call.headline_quote: these Industrials are simply not my passion because the risks are there the upside is there likely stable and then depending on the economy so nothing where I can have an edge on other analysts well covered all here so it's simply not for me

base_metric.name: eps
base_metric.quote: the consensus is for earnings per share of 11.37 compare that to the stock price that's a price earnings ratio of 8 from Kaiser Aluminum when things return to normal

reasons.claim: On normalized earnings the stock trades at a cheap P/E of 8, with a 5% dividend yield on top.
reasons.quote: that's a price earnings ratio of 8 from Kaiser Aluminum when things return to normal in the meantime you have a five percent dividend yield so nothing wrong there

data_check.gap_note: he says 8, as-of -56.9402 (FY2021); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Management took on too much debt for an acquisition just as EBITDA fell, pushing net debt/EBITDA up sharply and creating risk.
reasons.quote: as the ebitda went down because of issues the net debt to ebitda went up significantly and when you have these debt issues combined with negative periods then things get tricky and riskier

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: The business is diversified but into cyclical end markets, so a recession would hurt earnings and the market is already pricing that risk.
reasons.quote: if there is a recession ahead the market knows that you are not going to make a lot of money which makes it tricky

reasons.claim: Long-term growth outlook remains solid at roughly GDP-plus rates driven by more aluminum content in cars and aircraft.
reasons.quote: the growth Outlook is still perfect long term let's say four percent a little bit higher than GDP growth

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.04, as-of -1.64641 (FY2021); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Industrials like this are outside his circle of competence/passion, giving him no edge over well-covered analysts, so he passes despite the business being good.
reasons.quote: these Industrials are simply not my passion because the risks are there the upside is there likely stable and then depending on the economy so nothing where I can have an edge on other analysts well covered all here so it's simply not for me

external_facts_used: earnings per share consensus estimate of 11.37 when things normalize
CEO's letter/intro discussing issues at Warwick Rolling Mill, U.S. Magnesium, and Warwick smelter
acquisition EBITDA multiple went from about 1x to 4x
cumulative capital invested since 2007 (2.5x current market cap) in growth, dividends, and buybacks

critic.notes: He judges KALU a good/great business at current prices likely to do well once issues resolve, but passes personally for lack of edge — fits fair_hold (HOLD), not too_hard (SELL).
